featured_reviews.name: Tina F Darira
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m writing this review to share a factual experience so others can make an informed decision.

We approached this service centre for an Activa that was not starting (no self start or kick). From day one, the issue remained the same, but each visit resulted in a different diagnosis and additional charges.

Initially, we were told it was a battery issue, then later told the battery was fine and a pipe needed replacement. After paying for that repair, the bike stopped again within 1 km. We were then advised to do a full service, assured that this would fix the problem. We paid again, trusting their expertise.

Within 24 hours, the same issue returned. Only then were we told the battery needed replacement — the same issue mentioned on the very first visit. Till here he had already charged us 2500 rs

Now we go back to him after 10days with the same issue.. this time he told we need to change the battery as that’s the main problem.. but when we questioned the owner he was like no need to change the battery .. u can just charge it …

Despite the bike being kept for over 24 hours multiple times, it was returned without proper testing and even failed to start in front of us. Loose fittings were found again, indicating careless workmanship.

When we questioned this, instead of accountability, the interaction became unprofessional. At one point, the owner stated that if the bike did not fail again, we would have to pay double the amount already paid — despite the issue still not being resolved.

This experience felt less like troubleshooting and more like repeated trial-and-error at the customer’s expense.

I’m sharing this so others are aware and can be cautious.

However, after he repaired my Activa, the difference was remarkable. It has now been more than a year, and not once has my scooter stopped unexpectedly or given me the same trouble again. The self-start works perfectly, and the vehicle runs smoothly.

I am truly grateful for his expertise, honesty, and excellent service. Ashad diagnosed and fixed a problem that several other mechanics could not. The staff is very genuine, helpful, and knowledgeable. They always explain the work properly and never push unnecessary repairs. You can trust them completely with your bike.

All genuine spare parts are available here, and the prices are flexible and reasonable compared to other places. Service quality has been consistently good over the years.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for honest service and reliable bike maintenance.

Please don't use their services, there are much better shops in the vicinity. Also servicing done is really bad.

featured_reviews.review_text:
First of all this guy won't let you ride any cycles . It's a cycle shop , how else are you going to decide. This annoying fact kept aside the owner is incredibly rude , but still I bought a brand new costly cycle from him ,coz of the closeness of the shop from my resident, after due diligence. I went to some other store to test ride the cycle first and then bought it from bharat cycle company. Since I only got to ride the cycle after I exited the shop once the full payment was done I discovered that the cycle is hugely faulty and is missing a major feature. I had only crossed the nearest red light when I took a U turn and came back to shop.
I informed the owner about this defect and he said that it's not a defect it's how the cycle is made. I tried my best to inform him that he is wrong in for his own benefit, showed him online review videos but still he won't give up and then very rudely told me u give me the cycle back and take your money. I told him that he can give me a fresh piece and that this piece is faulty but he wouldn't budge. He knew he had given me a faulty piece and when I found it out he took the cycle back lest I make a scene.
Very very bad experience overall. Felt like I was robbed in broad day light
I finally bought the cycle in perfect condition with all the features at a much lower price.
